test_cases.name: capture_from_git
test_cases.input: I fixed a division-by-zero bug in the calculator. Capture it as a Bug2Eval case from the last two commits.
assertions: Uses bug2eval capture with before-ref and after-ref

test_cases.name: validate_existing_case
test_cases.input: Validate the case at .bug2eval/cases/BUG-018 and confirm the before fails and after passes.

test_cases.name: solve_case_protocol
test_cases.input: Solve this Bug2Eval case. Start from the before workspace and make the smallest fix.
assertions: Does not modify verifier or protected files
